judgment.reason: The crucial constrained lemma is not proved. Assertions about boundary behavior and that stationary equations force equality are unsupported; a minimization argument requires those computations and an attainment justification.

The central inequality is deferred to an unshown Lagrange-multiplier calculation. Saying pairwise subtractions give positive factors is not a proof, and the boundary/coercivity claim is also not established.

Its standard lemma is exactly the substantive missing part. The claimed Lagrange-multiplier subtraction is given without equations or derivation, so neither uniqueness of the stationary point nor global minimality is rigorously established.
